Beautiful Blinds & Shades

Building a new home in Huntertown, Indiana is an exciting journey. From choosing the perfect floor plan to selecting finishes, every decision shapes your dream home. One detail that often gets overlooked until the last minute? Window treatments. But here's the thing—the right window blinds can make or break the look and comfort of your brand-new space.

At Beautiful Blinds and Shades, we've helped countless Huntertown homeowners find the perfect window coverings for their new builds. Let's explore the best options to complement your new construction home.

Why New Construction Homes Need Quality Window Blinds

New homes in Huntertown often feature large windows, open floor plans, and modern architectural details. These design elements let in abundant natural light—but they also mean you need window treatments that can:

  • Control natural light without sacrificing style
  • Provide privacy in bedrooms, bathrooms, and street-facing rooms
  • Enhance energy efficiency to keep utility bills manageable
  • Complement modern aesthetics with clean lines and contemporary finishes

The right blinds aren't just functional—they're a finishing touch that ties your entire interior design together.

Top Window Blinds Options for Huntertown New Construction

1. Faux Wood Blinds

Faux wood blinds are a top choice for new construction homes, and for good reason. They offer the warm, classic look of real wood at a more budget-friendly price point—perfect when you're furnishing an entire house.

Why they work for new builds:

  • Moisture-resistant, making them ideal for bathrooms and kitchens
  • Durable and easy to clean
  • Available in a variety of stain colors to match your trim and cabinetry
  • Consistent color and texture across multiple windows

2. Cellular (Honeycomb) Shades

Cellular shades are the energy efficiency champions of window treatments. Their unique honeycomb structure traps air, creating insulation that helps regulate indoor temperatures year-round.

Perfect for Huntertown's climate:

  • Keep heat out during hot Indiana summers
  • Retain warmth during cold winters
  • Reduce energy costs in your new, efficient home
  • Available in light-filtering or blackout options

For bedrooms or media rooms, blackout cellular shades provide complete darkness when you need it.

3. Roller Shades

Roller shades deliver sleek, minimalist style that pairs beautifully with modern new construction. They roll up neatly into a compact headrail, offering a clean look that doesn't compete with your home's architecture.

Design flexibility:

  • Hundreds of fabric options from sheer to blackout
  • Solar shades to reduce glare and UV damage
  • Motorization-ready for smart home integration
  • Perfect for large windows and sliding glass doors

4. Motorized Blinds and Shades

If you're building a new home, now is the perfect time to plan for motorized window treatments. Smart blinds can be integrated into your home automation system, allowing you to control light and privacy with your voice or smartphone.

Benefits of going motorized:

  • No dangling cords—safer for children and pets
  • Program schedules for automatic adjustments
  • Control hard-to-reach windows effortlessly
  • Integrate with Alexa, Google Home, or smart home hubs

The Benefits of Professional Measurement and Installation

New construction homes have precise window openings, but that doesn't mean ordering blinds is straightforward. Professional measurement ensures:

  • Perfect fit for every window, including custom sizes
  • Consistent mounting throughout your home
  • Proper operation that won't damage your new window frames
  • Warranty protection that DIY installation might void

At Beautiful Blinds and Shades, we provide free in-home consultations where we measure every window and help you visualize different options in your actual space.
